cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen opens with header, filter field and key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Operator is signed on and selects Card Inquiry from the Main Menu, starting transaction ORCI.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Card Inquiry screen (transaction ORCI)
2. Read the whole screen without typing anything
cases.expected: The screen is drawn fresh (erased): header shows Tran `ORCI`, Pgm `OCCRDIN`, the title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM`, plus the current date and time. The `Filter:` entry field is empty, the category legend (ALL, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, Expiring-Soon) and the column headers (Card Number, Acct ID, Embossed Name, Expiry, St) are shown, the 13 list lines are blank, Page = 0, Active/Inactive = 0, and the message line shows `Type a filter and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 / §4 · map MCRDINA mapset MCRDIN · 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND ERASE) · msg WS-M-PROMPT

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: A populated result page maps each card to the five list columns
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL` into the Filter field
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list area and the footer
cases.expected: The five F-STD cards are listed, one per line, each showing Card Number (e.g. `4000000000000001`), Acct ID (`00000000001`), Embossed Name (`JOHN Q SMITH`), Expiry (`2027-03-31`) and Status (`Y`). The filter description echoes `ALL`, Page = 1, Active = 4, Inactive = 1, and the count line reads `5 shown - end of selection`.
cases.remark: UI §2.1 item list · 4300-PLACE-ROW / 4400-SHOW-TOTALS · KCI-R-* rows from CARDFILE

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the filter defaults to ALL, counts are zero and the cursor sits on the filter
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Operator has just entered transaction ORCI (first entry, no prior state).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Card Inquiry screen (ORCI)
2. Check the pre-filled values and the cursor position
cases.expected: The internal filter defaults to ALL and the description field shows `ALL`; Page = 0, Active = 0, Inactive = 0; the cursor is positioned on the `Filter:` field ready for input; the message line prompts `Type a filter and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL: MOVE 'A' TO filter, 'ALL' TO FDESCO, MOVE -1 TO FILTL (cursor) · WS-M-PROMPT

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Only the filter field is enterable; every list and total field is display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open, then a filter applied.
cases.steps:
1. On the fresh screen, try to move the cursor into a list line or a total field
2. Confirm only the Filter field accepts typing
3. Type filter `ACTIVE`, press ENTER
4. Confirm the Filter field is still enterable for a new filter while the results are display-only
cases.expected: Before and after applying a filter, only the `Filter:` field accepts input (it holds the initial focus); the header fields, the 13 card lines, the filter description, Page and the Active/Inactive totals are all protected/display-only and cannot be typed over. After ENTER the results are shown read-only and the Filter field remains open for the next inquiry.
cases.remark: UI §2.1 item-states: FILT ○ (UNPROT/IC), all others □ (ASKIP)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Filter ALL lists every card on the file
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (5 cards: 4 active + 1 inactive).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL` (or leave the field blank)
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list
cases.expected: All 5 cards are listed regardless of status — the four active cards (…0001, …0002, …0004, …0005) and the inactive card …0003. Filter description = `ALL`, Page = 1, count line `5 shown - end of selection`.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 4510-TEST-ALL (unconditional match) · replaces batch OBCARDP

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Filter ACTIVE lists only cards whose status is Y
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ACTIVE`
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list
cases.expected: Only the four active cards are listed (…0001, …0002, …0004, …0005), each with Status `Y`; the inactive card …0003 (`ROBERT B JOHNSON`) is excluded. Filter description = `ACTIVE`, count line `4 shown - end of selection`.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 4520-TEST-ACTIVE: CD-ACTIVE-STATUS = 'Y' · replaces OBRCARD

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Filter INACTIVE lists only cards whose status is not Y
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `INACTIVE`
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list
cases.expected: Only card …0003 (`ROBERT B JOHNSON`, Status `N`) is listed; the four active cards are excluded. Filter description = `INACTIVE`, count line `1 shown - end of selection`.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 4530-TEST-INACTIVE: CD-ACTIVE-STATUS NOT = 'Y'

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Filter Expiring-Soon lists cards expiring within the next 60 days
cases.precondition: F-EXP loaded: F-STD plus one card expiring `2026-09-28` (today) and one expiring `2026-11-27` (today+60). Today = 2026-09-28.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `EXP`
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list
cases.expected: Only the two cards whose expiry falls on or between `2026-09-28` and `2026-11-27` are listed; the far-future F-STD cards and the already-past card …0003 (`2026-01-31`) are excluded. Filter description = `EXPIRING`, count line shows `2 shown - end of selection`.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 4540-TEST-EXPIRING: WS-EXP-INT between today and today+60 · replaces OBCARDX

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Active and Inactive totals are tallied across the whole file on the first page
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (4 active, 1 inactive).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Read the Active and Inactive totals in the footer
3. Type filter `ACTIVE`, press ENTER
4. Read the totals again
cases.expected: For `ALL` the footer shows Active = 4 and Inactive = 1 (the whole-file population). For `ACTIVE` the footer shows Active = 4 and Inactive = 0 — the tally counts only the cards the filter selected. The totals are computed once on the first page.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 6000-COMPUTE-KPI (whole-file scan when KCI-DO-KPI) · ACTCNTO/INACNTO

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Result-count line shows more-pages vs end-of-selection wording
cases.precondition: F-PAGE loaded (20 active cards) for the more-pages case; F-STD for the end case.
cases.steps:
1. With F-PAGE, type filter `ALL`, press ENTER (page fills)
2. Read the message line
3. With F-STD, type filter `ALL`, press ENTER (fewer than 13)
4. Read the message line
cases.expected: When the page is full and more cards remain the line reads `13 shown - PF8=more PF7=top`. When the whole result fits on one page the line reads `5 shown - end of selection`. The leading number equals the row count on the current page.
cases.remark: 4900-BUILD-MSG: WS-M-MORE vs WS-M-DONE keyed on WS-ST-MORE

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: PF8 pages forward and PF7 returns to the top of the list
cases.precondition: F-PAGE loaded (20 active cards, so ALL spans two pages of 13 + 7).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER — page 1 of 13 rows
2. Press PF8
3. Read Page and the rows
4. Press PF7
5. Read Page and the rows
cases.expected: After ENTER, Page = 1 with 13 rows and `PF8=more`. PF8 advances to Page = 2 showing the remaining 7 cards (…0014 … …0020) with `end of selection`. PF7 re-lists from the top: Page = 1 with the first 13 cards again. Active/Inactive totals are unchanged across the pages.
cases.remark: 2300-PAGE-FWD (KCI-SKIP-KPI, WS-ST-NEXT-KEY) / 2200-RESTART · WS-ST-PAGE-NO

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-listing the same filter is idempotent and changes no data
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ACTIVE`, press ENTER — note the exact rows and totals
2. Press PF7 to restart the same filter from the top
3. Compare the rows and totals
4. Confirm the card file is unchanged
cases.expected: The PF7 restart returns exactly the same four active cards in the same order with Active = 4 / Inactive = 0, identical to the first listing. No card record is created, updated or deleted — the inquiry is read-only, so repeating it yields the same result every time.
cases.remark: UI §5 read-only (no C/U/D) · browse STARTBR GTEQ from LOW-VALUES · 2200-RESTART

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entry and resets the screen to its fresh state
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A filter has already been applied so the list and totals are populated.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ACTIVE`, press ENTER — results shown
2. Press PF4
3. Read the screen
cases.expected: The screen is redrawn fresh exactly like the initial display: the Filter field is cleared, the internal filter is back to ALL, the 13 list lines are blank, Page = 0, Active/Inactive = 0 and the prompt `Type a filter and press ENTER.` is shown, with the cursor back on the Filter field.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: CLEAR redisplays a fresh screen
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A filter has already been applied.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `INACTIVE`, press ENTER — results shown
2. Press CLEAR
3. Read the screen
cases.expected: The CLEAR key redisplays the fresh screen (same reset as PF4): Filter cleared, internal filter ALL, blank list, Page = 0, totals 0 and the prompt `Type a filter and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHCLEAR → 1000-SEND-INITIAL

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: ENTER hands the filter to the card browse engine and shows the returned page
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open. The card browse engine sub-program is available in the CICS region.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`
2. Press ENTER
3. Confirm the listed page came back from the browse engine
cases.expected: The screen calls the card browse engine (a sub-program) passing the chosen filter and a top-of-file start key, and paints the page of cards, the resume key and the Active/Inactive tallies it returns — the screen itself performs no file access. The five F-STD cards and totals (Active 4 / Inactive 1) are shown.
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB: EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('OUCRDIN') COMMAREA(KCRDIN-AREA) · engine reads CARDFILE

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open (with or without results).
cases.steps:
1. Press PF3
2. Observe the screen transition
cases.expected: Control is handed to the Main Menu program and the Main Menu screen is shown; the originating program/transaction is passed along so the menu knows where the operator came from.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU: EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM('OCMENU') · CA-FROM-PROGRAM/TRANID

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: PF12 also cancels and returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Press PF12
2. Observe the screen transition
cases.expected: PF12 behaves like PF3: control transfers to the Main Menu program and the Main Menu screen is shown.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF12 → 7000-XCTL-MENU (same path as PF3)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Exactly 13 matching cards fill a single page with no further page
cases.precondition: F-PAGE trimmed to exactly 13 active cards (…0001 … …0013).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Read all 13 rows and the count line
3. Press PF8
cases.expected: All 13 rows are filled (the maximum per page). Because no 14th card exists the count line reads `13 shown - end of selection`, and pressing PF8 shows `End of selection - no more cards.` (no empty second page).
cases.remark: WS-MAX-ROWS = 13 · 3000-BROWSE-DRIVER sets KCI-NO-MORE at end · lower/at boundary of page size

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A 14th matching card spills onto a second page
cases.precondition: F-PAGE trimmed to exactly 14 active cards (…0001 … …0014).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Read page 1 and the count line
3. Press PF8
4. Read page 2
cases.expected: Page 1 shows the first 13 cards with `13 shown - PF8=more PF7=top`. PF8 shows Page = 2 with the single remaining card (…0014) and `1 shown - end of selection`. This is the max+1 side of the 13-row page boundary.
cases.remark: KCI-MORE set when KCI-ROW-COUNT >= WS-MAX-ROWS and not BR-END · resume via WS-ST-NEXT-KEY

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Expiring-Soon window includes today and today+60, excludes today+61 and past
cases.precondition: F-EXP loaded with four probe cards: expiry `2026-09-28` (today), `2026-11-27` (today+60), `2026-11-28` (today+61), `2026-09-27` (yesterday). Today = 2026-09-28.
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `EXP`, press ENTER
2. Check which probe cards appear
cases.expected: The card expiring `2026-09-28` (day 0) and the card expiring `2026-11-27` (day 60) are listed; the card expiring `2026-11-28` (day 61) and the already-expired card `2026-09-27` are excluded. The window is inclusive on both ends and rejects past dates.
cases.remark: 4540-TEST-EXPIRING: WS-EXP-INT >= WS-TODAY-INT AND <= WS-CUT-INT (today+60) · 2000-COMPUTE-CUTOFF

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Expiring-Soon skips cards with an undated or unparseable expiry
cases.precondition: F-EXP loaded with a card whose expiry is blank (`----------`) or non-numeric, plus one valid in-window card (`2026-10-15`).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `EXP`, press ENTER
2. Check the undated card is not listed
cases.expected: The card with the blank/unparseable expiry is not selected under Expiring-Soon (it cannot be placed in the 60-day window); only the valid in-window card `2026-10-15` appears. Note: the same card WOULD appear under the `ALL` filter (which ignores expiry).
cases.remark: 4000-DERIVE-FIGURES gates on CD-EXPIRY-DATE numeric → WS-EXP-VALID; invalid ⇒ no match in 4540

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Filter matches on the leading 3 characters and is case-insensitive
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Type `act` (lower case), press ENTER
2. Type `ACTIVE`, press ENTER
3. Type `ACTXYZ`, press ENTER
4. Type `AL` (two letters), press ENTER
cases.expected: `act`, `ACTIVE` and `ACTXYZ` are all treated as ACTIVE (the entry is up-cased and only the first 3 characters are matched), each listing the four active cards. `AL` (only two of the three characters of `ALL`) is not recognised and produces `Filter not recognised - see the list above.`
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-FILTER: INSPECT CONVERTING to upper, WS-FILT-IN(1:3) compare; 'AL ' matches nothing ⇒ invalid

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A blank filter defaults to ALL
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Filter field empty
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list
cases.expected: A blank filter is accepted and treated as `ALL`: all 5 cards are listed, filter description `ALL`, count line `5 shown - end of selection`. No error is shown.
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-FILTER WHEN WS-FILT-IN = SPACES → 'A' (ALL); empty-input boundary of the only input field

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: List columns render at their full defined widths
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (Embossed Name `LINDA C WILLIAMS`, `ROBERT B JOHNSON`).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Inspect each column width against the defined field sizes
cases.expected: Each row renders Card Number in 16 characters (`4000000000000004`), Acct ID as 11 digits (`00000000004`), Embossed Name in up to 20 characters (`LINDA C WILLIAMS` shown in full), Expiry in 10 characters as an ISO date (`2029-11-30`) and Status in 1 character (`Y`/`N`). A name at the full 20-character width is displayed without overflow into the Expiry column.
cases.remark: RCARD/KCRDIN PIC: CD-NUM X(16), CD-ACCT-ID 9(11), CD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(20 shown), CD-EXPIRY X(10), CD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) · BMS field lengths

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported key is rejected with an invalid-key message
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Press an unsupported key such as PF1 or PF5
2. Read the message line
cases.data: Key = PF1 (any key other than ENTER/PF3/PF4/PF7/PF8/PF12/CLEAR)
cases.expected: The action is rejected, the current filter description is kept and the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.` The screen stays on Card Inquiry with the data preserved.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (copybook WMSG); SEND DATAONLY

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unrecognised filter keyword is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Type a keyword that is not a filter, e.g. `FOO`
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the message line
cases.expected: No browse is performed and the message line shows `Filter not recognised - see the list above.` The cursor returns to the Filter field so the operator can retype one of ALL / ACTIVE / INACTIVE / Expiring-Soon.
cases.remark: 2100-APPLY-FILTER: 6000-PARSE-FILTER sets WS-INVALID → WS-M-BAD-FILTER, MOVE -1 TO FILTL

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A filter that matches nothing reports no cards found
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (no card expires within 60 days of today 2026-09-28).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `EXP`
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list area and the message line
cases.expected: The list area stays blank and the message line shows `No cards match that filter.` Page = 1 and the filter description shows `EXPIRING`. (The same message appears for any filter over an empty CARDFILE.)
cases.remark: 4000-SHOW-PAGE WHEN KCI-ROW-COUNT = 0 → WS-M-NONE-FOUND

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Paging past the last page reports end of selection
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (a single page of 5 cards under ALL).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER (all 5 shown, `end of selection`)
2. Press PF8
3. Read the message line
cases.data: Filter = `ALL`; PF8 on the last page
cases.expected: No further page exists, so the list is left unchanged and the message line shows `End of selection - no more cards.`
cases.remark: 2300-PAGE-FWD: WS-ST-MORE NOT = 'Y' → WS-M-END-FILE

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: PF7 before any filter is applied asks the operator to apply one first
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry just opened; no ENTER/filter applied yet.
cases.steps:
1. On the fresh screen, press PF7
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: Because nothing has been listed yet, no browse runs and the message line shows `Apply a filter first (press ENTER).` The cursor is placed on the Filter field.
cases.remark: 2200-RESTART: WS-ST-LISTED NOT = 'Y' → WS-M-LIST-FIRST (trigger point = PF7)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: PF8 before any filter is applied asks the operator to apply one first
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Inquiry just opened; no ENTER/filter applied yet.
cases.steps:
1. On the fresh screen, press PF8
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: Because nothing has been listed yet, no page-forward runs and the message line shows `Apply a filter first (press ENTER).` — the same guard as PF7 but reached through the page-forward key.
cases.remark: 2300-PAGE-FWD: WS-ST-LISTED NOT = 'Y' → WS-M-LIST-FIRST (distinct trigger point = PF8)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A failed link to the browse engine reports it cannot be reached
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. The card browse engine sub-program is disabled/undefined in the CICS region so the link fails (e.g. PGMIDERR).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: The link to the browse engine fails, so no rows are shown and the message line shows `Unable to reach the card browse engine.` The screen stays put so the operator can retry.
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB: LINK RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) → WS-INVALID + WS-M-LINK-ERR (env-fault, one representative)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A browse failure inside the engine reports a card-file error
cases.precondition: F-STD present but CARDFILE is closed/disabled so the engine's browse fails (STARTBR/READNEXT returns an abnormal response).
cases.steps:
1. Type filter `ALL`, press ENTER
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: The browse engine returns an error indicator, so no rows are shown and the message line shows `Error browsing the card file.` The screen stays on Card Inquiry.
cases.remark: OUCRDIN 3100/3300 abnormal RESP → KCI-ERROR; 3000-CALL-SUB WHEN KCI-ERROR → WS-M-BROWSE-ERR
